project.title: GreenJobs Platform Rebuild for GreenJobs Ltd
project.cover_subtitle: Both GreenJobs boards rebuilt, migrated to a platform you own, and maintained month to month. €1,500 at signing, migration included, €600 a month locked for 6 months.

situation.headline: The GreenJobs boards are ready for their next platform.
situation.lede: You have told me you are considering moving greenjobs.ie and greenjobs.co.uk to a platform you own, with hosting and integrations you control and changes delivered on your own timetable. Since 22 September I have built and tested exactly that: 195 pages on 165 live roles, all 100 front-end items from your change document, and 3,047 automated checks passing.
situation.callout_body: hosting plus integrations, with the same guarantees you have today, Broadbean, Idibu and LogicMelon continuing to post without interruption, an easy way for your recruiters to post from their CRM, and GreenJobs staff posting ads themselves.
situation.close: This proposal covers the rebuild you have already reviewed, the migration, and the monthly maintenance, with every number on one page.

problems_heading: Four things the current setup leaves on the table.

problems.title: Owning the platform
problems.body: Changes to the boards wait on a third party's timetable. On a platform you own, your team posts, edits and features roles from a console built for GreenJobs, and changes ship when you need them.

problems.title: Reaching candidates where they search
problems.body: Job pages do not currently carry Google JobPosting structured data, so roles do not appear in Google for Jobs. Adding it, with salary shown wherever the employer provides one, extends the reach of every Premium posting.

problems.title: Speed on mobile
problems.body: Current pages weigh about a megabyte per visit. The rebuilt boards serve the same content in under 200 KB with no third-party requests, which matters most to mobile visitors, the majority of job seekers.

problems.title: Live figures and a dashboard
problems.body: Counts by county, sector and salary band are maintained by hand today. On the new platform every figure is computed from the job data on each post, with a KPI dashboard for you and your site manager.

benefits.title: Both editions rebuilt
benefits.body: greenjobs.ie and greenjobs.co.uk as demonstrated: jobs board with filters, list, map and saved views; one page per role with JobPosting data; 14-sector taxonomy; salary insights and guide; career quiz; employers page with Premium and Membership comparison and a live post-a-job preview; four SEO landing pages; KPI dashboard.

benefits.title: Your own platform
benefits.body: Admin posting console for GreenJobs staff; candidate accounts with stored CV, one-click apply, saved roles and email job alerts; Broadbean, Idibu and LogicMelon posting kept and verified by a daily test job; recruiter CRM posting integration; full data export and import; a 301 redirect for every indexed URL.

benefits.title: Hosting with the guarantees you have today
benefits.body: 99.9% uptime, daily backups with a tested restore every quarter, firewall, DDoS protection and SSL, 24/7 monitoring, EU data region, daily integration checks and a monthly report.

benefits.title: Numbers that update themselves
benefits.body: Every figure on the site is computed from the job data on every post, whether GreenJobs staff or a client uploads the ad, so nothing goes stale and nothing is typed twice.

scope.heading: Six weeks from signature to go-live.
scope.m1_body: Both editions live on your domains within 5 working days of signature, all 100 completed change-document items included, JobPosting data on every role, sitemaps and redirects. Indicative: live by Monday 13 October 2026 if signed by 6 October.
scope.m2_title: Weeks 2 to 4. Platform build and staging
scope.m2_body: Posting console, candidate accounts, alerts, Broadbean / Idibu / LogicMelon endpoints, recruiter CRM integration, data import, redirect map; staging acceptance with you and your site manager. Indicative: 14 October to 3 November 2026.
scope.m3_title: Weeks 5 to 6. Parallel run and go-live
scope.m3_body: Two weeks alongside the current platform with a test job through every posting route each day, then DNS cut-over and 10 working days of daily checks. Indicative go-live: Wednesday 18 November 2026.
scope.throughout: Weekly update, one business day response, 4-hour response to a posting outage, and all work in accounts GreenJobs owns so nothing is locked to me. Dates move day for day with the signature date and any late input (contract details, posting routes in use, DNS access, logo permissions). Broadbean onboarding runs on Broadbean's timeline.
scope.out_of_scope: Employer self-service purchasing and card payment for job packages (GreenJobs staff post the ads); the other eight sites in the GreenJobs network; career-advice articles or market reports; paid advertising; any fees charged by Broadbean, Idibu, LogicMelon or the current platform provider. Anything else is quoted in writing before it starts.

investment.heading: Simple, fixed, in euro.
investment.m1_deliverable: Front-end rebuild, both editions, live on your domains within 5 working days of signature
investment.m2_deliverable: Platform migration, in exchange for a LinkedIn post about the build, a post on the Gaia Talent and GreenJobs pages at go-live, and a short written testimonial
investment.m3_deliverable: Maintain, locked at this price for 6 months: hosting, backups, 24/7 monitoring, security, daily checks on Broadbean, Idibu, LogicMelon and your CRM route, Google for Jobs kept indexed, every figure on the site kept live, your team's content and change requests handled as they come. Covers the two boards; further sites agreed in writing first.
investment.roi_title: Tool subscriptions, in your name, billed at cost +3%
investment.roi_body: Cloudflare Workers Paid plan $5 per month (hosting, database, storage) and Resend Pro $20 per month (job alerts, newsletter, transactional email). Domains and DNS are already yours. Prices checked on the vendors' pages on 30 September 2026.

agreement.body: ProdCraft will build and maintain the GreenJobs platform for GreenJobs Ltd according to this proposal. The build fee is due at signing; the migration is included on the terms above; the monthly plan is €600, fixed for 6 months from the day the front end goes live, charged upfront at the start of each cycle, then rolling with 30 days' written notice. Anything already paid is not refunded. All infrastructure, data and source code belong to GreenJobs Ltd. Additional features or integrations outside the listed scope are agreed in writing first. This offer is held until Friday 10 October 2026. Questions: debanjan@prodcraft.fyi.
